reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web GUI visual theme plugin that applies a Touhou Hakurei Shrine skin with theme-aware backgrounds, decorative panels, character imagery, and reversible client-side styling changes.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供博丽神社主题皮肤，包含昼夜背景、灵梦立绘、半透明面板及可切换的亮暗主题界面。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web GUI theme skin featuring Hakurei Shrine day-and-night backgrounds, Reimu artwork, translucent panels, and light-dark theme switching.

capabilities: Modifies client-side CSS and DOM for a visual skin
Switches backgrounds and interface styling with light and dark themes
Adds decorative character layers, collapsible panels, and animation hooks
Restores CSS and DOM changes when the effect is destroyed
